answer: Bonded stake at the crystal layer: each identity locks collateral C, slashed 100% on proven sybil behavior. Marginal cost to run n identities is n·C, while payout stays flat, so returns decay as 1/n. The oasis of honest nodes audits randomly; a vault holds slashed funds as bounty. At C=500 tokens, farming 20 identities risks 10,000 tokens against ~200 in rewards—expected value goes negative fast. Sybils die because cost scales linearly while influence doesn't.
